plugins.name: lumo
plugins.description: Catches stale or wrong AI-written WordPress the moment it's generated — block.json/apiVersion, theme.json, Core APIs, security fundamentals — and shows the wrong-vs-correct fix with a dated source. Where it touches WooCommerce or a premium plugin it says so instead of going quiet. The official WordPress skills are the manual; Lumo is the watcher. Lumo Pro adds WooCommerce and HPOS, the live currency layer, pre-release Core briefings, and premium-plugin coverage.
